surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 15 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Ash-Shams (The Sun) is the 91th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 15 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ وَالشَّمْسِ وَضُحَاهَا
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم والشمس وضحاها
ayahs.translation_saheeh: By the sun and its brightness
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: By the sun in its morning brightness

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] the moon when it follows it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and by the moon as it follows it

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] the day when it displays it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: by the day as it displays the sun’s glory

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] the night when it covers it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and by the night as it conceals it

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: by the sky and how He built it

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] the earth and He who spread it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and by the earth and how He spread it

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: by the soul and how He formed it

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and inspired it [to know] its own rebellion and piety

ayahs.translation_saheeh: He has succeeded who purifies it
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The one who purifies his soul succeeds

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the one who corrupts it fails

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: In their arrogant cruelty, the people of Thamud called [their messenger] a liar

ayahs.translation_saheeh: When the most wretched of them was sent forth
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when the most wicked man among them rose [against him]

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَقَالَ لَهُمۡ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقۡيَٰهَا
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ نَاقَةَ اللَّهِ وَسُقْيَاهَا
ayahs.arabic_clean: فقال لهم رسول الله ناقة الله وسقياها
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The messenger of God said to them, ‘[Leave] God’s camel to drink,’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمۡدَمَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمۡ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ بِذَنْبِهِمْ فَسَوَّاهَا
ayahs.arabic_clean: فكذبوه فعقروها فدمدم عليهم ربهم بذنبهم فسواها
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but they called him a liar and hamstrung her. Their Lord destroyed them for their crime and levelled them

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And He does not fear the consequence thereof
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He did not hesitate to punish them
